title: Demo breadcrumb only swaps the home segment; all other segments still link to real /vacancies/* routes, contradicting the stated sandbox guarantee
detail: The doc comment promises an in-demo breadcrumb never exits the sandbox, but only the home href uses `home`; VacancyDetail, VacancyHandoff, ApplicationDetail and Compare segments keep hardcoded /vacancies/<id> links, which in demo mode are fake ids on real production routes.
recommended_fix: Route non-home hrefs through a demo-aware helper (e.g. prefix /demo or suppress links when demo=True), or correct the comment to state only the home link is sandboxed.

title: New landlord-facing copy hardcoded inline in views instead of copy.gleam
evidence:
html.text(
            "Demo - nothing is saved. This is mock data, refreshed every visit.",
          ),
...
          [html.text("Create your vacancy →")],
...
          [html.text("↺ Reset demo")],
...
              [
                html.text(case model.demo_mode {
                  True -> "Exit demo"
                  False -> "Sign out"
                }),
              ],
detail: Demo banner and shell introduce user-facing strings inline in the view modules. This project's convention centralises all landlord-facing copy in copy.gleam; inlining new copy breaks that single-source rule and brand-voice review.
recommended_fix: Move "Demo - nothing is saved...", "Create your vacancy →", "↺ Reset demo", and "Exit demo" into copy.gleam and reference them from the views.

title: Demo-mode home breadcrumb is labelled "Dashboard" but links to /demo
detail: When demo=True the crumb labelled "Dashboard" navigates to /demo, whose own breadcrumb labels itself "Demo". The same destination is presented under two different labels depending on which route renders the breadcrumb.
recommended_fix: Use a demo-aware label (e.g. "Demo") for the home segment when demo=True so the label matches the destination.
